gold.name: Gold
gold.description: Shiny, valuable, and totally irresistible to goblins.

stone.name: Stone
stone.description: Hard, heavy, and perfect for stubbing your toe.

wood.name: Wood
wood.description: Nature’s original building block. Smells like adventure.

ore.name: Ore
ore.description: A rock with dreams of becoming something more.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.description: Burnt wood, but make it useful.

nails.name: Nails
nails.description: Tiny metal spikes with a point to prove.

bow.name: Bow
bow.description: For when you want to poke things from a distance.

fiber.name: Fiber
fiber.description: A versatile material used in crafting and building. Also, not edible.

cloth.name: Cloth
cloth.description: Soft, comfy, and perfect for making things that are not armor.

cake.name: Cake
cake.description: A delicious treat that brings joy and a bit of frosting to your day. Essential for breeding.

stone spear.name: Stone Spear
stone spear.description: Pointy rock on a stick. Classic.

verdant egg.name: Verdant Egg
verdant egg.description: Green and mysterious. May hatch a salad.

damp egg.name: Damp Egg
damp egg.description: Moist to the touch. Smells like rain.

electric egg.name: Electric Egg
electric egg.description: Crack it open for a shocking surprise.

dark egg.name: Dark Egg
dark egg.description: Mysterious and brooding. Probably listens to metal.
